card.name: Start of capitalized brand drug names
card.fires_on: The first piece of an all-caps brand drug name right after a verb or preposition like discontinue, initiate, with, or of. The name is only partly written so far and the rest of the capitals follow.

modes.label: After action verbs
modes.description: Brand name begins right after a verb such as discontinue, initiate or administer.
modes.example: If heart failure develops or worsens and requires hospitalization, discontinue<< MULT>>AQ. 5.5 Liver Injury

modes.label: After with or of
modes.description: Brand name begins after a preposition in sentences about treatment, doses or co-administration.
modes.example: Rosuvastatin may be administered with<< MAV>>YRET at a dose that does not

modes.label: Inside a name later in the sentence
modes.description: A later piece of an all-caps brand name, such as a product with several parts.
modes.example: discontinuation of PREMPRO or<< PRE>>MPHASE therapy with institution of appropriate

card.writes: No clear meaning; the promoted tokens look like code or markup pieces, so it adds little readable output.
card.plain: It lights up at the first letters of a capitalized brand drug name, before the rest of the name appears.
